reason: We've grown fast and I know some older clients are on agreements priced for half the users they've got now. If it's 45 minutes with someone else doing the exports, and it's free unless it finds a grand I agree with, I'll book it. I'd only keep paying the £99 a month if the first report actually holds up.
objection: Our ticket categories are a mess, so I expect half the 'unbilled time' to be wrong or stuff we deliberately give away. If I have to spend an afternoon arguing with the report line by line, it's dead to me.
would_change_my_mind: If the report comes back full of false positives from our miscategorised tickets, or if the DPA and data handling look flimsy when I read them, I'd walk away before the subscription starts.
